items.title: JPMorgan Just Removed Alphabet From Its Analyst Focus List
items.summary: Google's search queries just hit a five-year growth high, yet revenue lagged far behind. JPMorgan spotted the gap, and it is steering its near-term conviction toward a rival while keeping a bullish long-term view.

items.title: JPMorgan Just Added Meta Platforms to Its Analyst Focus List
items.summary: Meta's stock had slid for a month when JPMorgan quietly handed it a coveted spot, with no rating and no price target attached. What did the bank see in the ad numbers, and what risks still hide behind the AI spending spree?

items.title: Tronox Holdings (TROX) Stock Fair Value Falls As Analysts Cut Targets On Demand Concerns
items.summary: Tronox Holdings has seen its Fair Value estimate cut from US$5.50 to US$4.75, a reduction of about 14% that directly affects how some investors may think about upside from current levels. This reset lines up with recent Street research, where bearish analysts have shifted Tronox Holdings price targets into a US$3.50 to US$5 range as they weigh titanium dioxide market conditions, end market demand, and rating changes from firms such as JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs. items.title: Meta and Amazon Rise 5% as JPMorgan Names Them Top Internet Picks; Alphabet Gains 3% Despite Losing Its Spot
items.summary: JPMorgan just reshuffled its favorite internet stocks, and one household name got cut yet still rallied. Find out which rival Meta displaced, why analysts say its ad engine is outrunning Google Search, and what could still derail the rotation.

items.title: After the Democratic Midterm Sweep: 4 Dividend Stocks Built for Gridlock
items.summary: When Congress locks up, some dividends barely notice. Four blue chips span power, soap, medicine and banking, and one of them already survived a payout collapse that income investors should not forget before trusting it.

items.title: Will PNC Financial's Expanding Branch Network Fuel Long-Term Growth?
items.summary: PNC plans to invest $2.5 billion to add more than 370 branches by 2031, targeting high-growth markets to drive customer, deposit and lending growth.

items.title: JPMorgan drops Alphabet from focus list, adds Meta on AI advertising gains
items.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan has removed Alphabet from its Analyst Focus List and added Meta Platforms, betting that AI-driven advertising gains and emerging monetization opportunities make Meta the more attractive internet stock.
